pergunta: Which brand grew the most in 2025?
sql_referencia: SELECT b.brand_name FROM sales_by_brand s JOIN brands b ON s.brand_id = b.brand_id WHERE s.year = 2025 ORDER BY s.growth_pct DESC, b.brand_name LIMIT 1
